title: A Unified Loss for Handling Inter-Class and Intra-Class Imbalance in Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Majority-class hard mining strength set per image by the frequency of minority classes present, plus within-class hard mining.
adaptation: Per-cell control: light majority mining on crack-free cells, heavy on cracked cells. Alternative to asymmetric margin.
min_experiment: Arm: Balance loss replacing CE, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100; metric mIoU_rob and crack recall; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01.
evidence: R: better than common losses on 5 medical segmentation tasks with varying imbalance (abstract level).
